title: RoutingRuleInput
description: Body of POST /routing-rules and PUT /routing-rules/{ruleId} (on PUT, project_id, action_kind, match, action and on_failure are replaced: an absent project_id means every project, an absent match means every request, an absent on_failure clears the failure policy; name, priority and enabled are kept when absent or null). Unknown keys are a 422, at the top level and inside match, action and on_failure.

project_id.description: A proj_… id in this workspace; null or absent = every project. The project must be enabled when newly targeted; re-sending the rule's current project is accepted even if it was disabled since. Replaced on PUT.

name.description: Unique in the workspace. On create, null or absent = generated from the rule. On PUT, null or absent = unchanged.

priority.description: On create, null or absent = placed after the existing rules. On PUT, null or absent = unchanged.

enabled.description: Absent = true on create, unchanged on update or replace. Boolean only: null is a 422.

provider.description: One of openai, anthropic, google, deepseek, mistral. An unknown provider is a 422 on this field.

action.description: auto: quality_bias defaults to 50. failover: strategy defaults to sequential.

id.description: Response field (read-only). Absent or null on create; on update it may be echoed back only with its current value — anything else is a 422 immutable_field.

workspace_id.description: Response field (read-only). Absent or null on create; on update it may be echoed back only with its current value — anything else is a 422 immutable_field.
